questions.prompt: What is an Azure virtual network (VNet)?

options.text: A private, isolated network in an Azure region where resources get private IPs

questions.explanation: A VNet is your own private, isolated network in a region, divided into subnets, where resources get private IP addresses and communicate.

questions.prompt: Which are valid load-balancing services in Azure? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Load Balancer (L4), Application Gateway (regional L7), and Front Door (global L7) distribute traffic. Key Vault is a secrets store, not a load balancer.

questions.prompt: Allow/deny rules that filter traffic by IP, port, and protocol are configured in a ____ security group.
questions.explanation: A network security group (NSG) filters traffic with allow/deny rules by source/destination IP, port, and protocol, attached to a subnet or NIC.

questions.prompt: Order the path of an inbound request to a web VM from OUTERMOST to the VM.
questions.explanation: Traffic comes from the internet, is distributed by a load balancer, filtered by the NSG, and then reaches the VM.

questions.prompt: Match each connectivity option to its description.

pairs.right: Encrypted tunnel over the public internet
Private, dedicated connection (not over the internet)
Global layer-7 routing with CDN and WAF
Hosts DNS domains and resolves names

questions.explanation: VPN Gateway is an internet tunnel; ExpressRoute is a private link; Front Door is global L7; Azure DNS hosts your domains.
